resolution.note: fast on a one-file src/hosts/codex.ts change: related tests 20-27 s on main -> 6-12 s (19 tests, same selection). Cause: every CodexHost test waited the 1000 ms drain quiet period and two tests waited full 5-7 s deadlines; CodexHost takes drainQuietMs, drain/wait take deadlines, tests pass short ones. Export-level selection dropped: it would lose tests importing the changed module. Host-load registration flakes reproduce equally on main (t-0c0gcmc).

title: fast: select only tests importing the changed export and run tsc beside tests
body: Roadmap R1. A/B v5 (.krn/runs/lead/krn-ab/report-v5.md): KRN arm 51 s vs 37 s in v4 and 15 s slower than plain; the fast tool call took 27-28 s in-run, tests 13-14 s of it. Outcome: npm run fast on a one-file change is at least 5 s faster on the same input, measured before/after, with no loss of tests that import the changed module.
